build_efficientnet_trunk: build an EfficientNet trunk wrapper for feature extraction at multiple layers using ClassyVision
create_efficientnet_model: create an EfficientNet model trunk with configurable version and input type from AttrDict config
extract_features_efficientnet: extract intermediate features from EfficientNet blocks by specifying out_feat_keys in forward pass
register_efficientnet_trunk: register EfficientNet as a model trunk with the vissl model trunk registry
run_efficientnet_forward: run EfficientNet forward pass with selective feature extraction from stem through final conv blocks
